title: Server-side Renown sessions use RENOWN_SESSION_COOKIE plus verifyRenownSession in a Data Access Layer
content:
## The flow

**1. On login** the client mints a bearer token (`renown.getBearerToken()`) and stores it — with a `RenownSessionProfile` display hint (`name`/`avatar` plus `documentId`/`username`/`userImage`) — in an **HttpOnly cookie**. The name is exported as `RENOWN_SESSION_COOKIE` and the value is built with `serializeRenownSessionCookie`. `RenownProvider`'s session-cookie sync does this automatically when given a `session`. Type the route handler with the exported `RenownSessionCookie` rather than redeclaring the payload shape.

**2. A Data Access Layer** reads the cookie and calls `verifyRenownSession`, memoized per request:

```typescript
import { RENOWN_SESSION_COOKIE, verifyRenownSession } from "@renown/sdk/node";

const cookie = (await cookies()).get(RENOWN_SESSION_COOKIE)?.value;
return (await verifyRenownSession(cookie, { switchboardUrl: SWITCHBOARD_URL })) ?? null;
```

## What verification actually checks

By default `verifyRenownSession` verifies the **JWT only** — signature and expiry — and merges the display hint into `user` as *unverified, display-only* data, rebuilding `user.ens` and, when `documentId` is present, `user.profile`.

Pass **`verifyCredential: true`** to also re-check the credential against the Switchboard, so a **revoked or expired credential is rejected**. It defaults to `false`, which is token-only and does no network call. That default is the gotcha: a revoked credential still presents a valid, unexpired JWT, so the default path keeps admitting a user whose credential has been pulled until the token itself expires.

## The one thing never to use for access control

`readSessionClaims(cookieValue)` gives a cheap, **signature-free** decode. It is for optimistic checks only — an edge redirect, for instance. Never trust it for access control: an attacker can author any claims they like in a cookie they control, and a signature-free decode will happily return them.

_Source: apps/academy/docs/academy/04-Reference/06-Authorization/renown-sdk/01-Authentication.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45)._
description: verifyRenownSession checks JWT signature and expiry only by default; pass verifyCredential true to reject revoked credentials. readSessionClaims is never valid for access control.
